summary: Complete Revised Stage 1 Architecture & Implementation Plan for the ZIRO Digital Internship AI Manufacturing Incident and Maintenance Response Platform. Formally designates Gemini model ID as Pending API Model Verification, adds dedicated Dataset 3 telemetry analytics endpoint and dashboard tab, standardizes measurement units (separating motor load % from motor power kW and labeling unverified units), institutes strict tri-category data labeling (EMPIRICAL DATASET, SIMULATED, DEMO), preserves the unified incident permissions policy, and enforces the complete 7-stage manufacturing data pipeline.
